data.title: Where Claude keeps *your memory*
data.subtitle: Read it now and then. Fix what's out of date.

rows.label: Your memory
rows.detail: Everything it remembers, listed under Topics

steps: Click your initials, then **Settings → Your Claude**
Click **Manage** next to **Your memory** to read or fix topics
data.note: Drawn from Anthropic's help pages, not a screenshot. In the older Settings layout, memory is under Settings → Memory. Your screen may differ.
